decision_status_reason: The client has not specified the optical measurement techniques being considered, nor the temperature range or the nature of material build-up, which are critical for selecting suitable methods and probes.

stated: Developing a hot polymer extrusion process.
The process incorporates an active pharmaceutical ingredient.
Interested in detecting composition changes during processing using optical measurement.
The process interface may be exposed to material build up.

unknowns.item: Specific optical measurement techniques being considered
unknowns.why_it_matters: Different techniques have varying sensitivities and capabilities for detecting composition changes.
Temperature affects the choice of materials and design of the optical probe.

unknowns.item: Nature and extent of material build up
unknowns.why_it_matters: Material build up can affect the accuracy and maintenance of the optical probe.
Different ingredients may have different optical properties, affecting detection capability.

unknowns.item: Desired sensitivity and accuracy of the measurement
unknowns.why_it_matters: Determines the specifications and suitability of the optical probe.

assumptions: The optical measurement needs to be in-line with the process.
The optical probe must withstand high temperatures and potential material build up.

clarification_questions.question: What specific optical measurement techniques are being considered?
What is the temperature range of the process?
What is the nature and extent of material build-up at the process interface?
What is the type of active pharmaceutical ingredient being used?
What is the desired sensitivity and accuracy of the measurement?

measurement_concept.summary: Cannot be defined yet due to insufficient information on the process conditions and measurement requirements.
measurement_concept.fiber_link_note: The fiber link requirements depend on the temperature and material build-up conditions, which are not yet specified.

citations.supports: The need for high-speed spectral acquisition and real-time results in online measurements.

risks.risk: High temperature and material build-up may damage the probe or affect measurement accuracy.
risks.mitigation: Select probes and materials that are resistant to high temperatures and can be easily cleaned or replaced.

feasibility_plan.objective: To determine the feasibility of using optical spectroscopy for in-line monitoring of composition changes in a hot polymer extrusion process.
samples_or_process_states: Hot polymer melt with active pharmaceutical ingredient.
comparisons: Compare in-line spectral data with offline assay results.
steps: Determine process conditions such as temperature and material build-up.
Select appropriate probes and fibers based on process conditions.
Conduct initial tests to compare in-line and offline results.
feasibility_plan.go_no_go_basis: Comparison of in-line spectral data with offline assay results to determine if the optical method can reliably detect composition changes.
